instrumentation: Actual unpacked/packaged extension and genuine WebXR DevTools panel, application actuator calls, real WebGL, RAF and timers.

Controlled backend source activation and session visibility for deterministic retirement/visibility checks; native child removal for pagehide. Separate deterministic clock tests replay stale callbacks.

Cross-realm calls use separately injected live documents; no public registration hook or hardware vibration. Panel text, computed background and independent left/right states observed before acknowledgement.
